mapper.select: SELECT hp.employee_no AS employeeNo, hp.name_ko AS nameKo, hp.grade_code AS gradeCode, cg.code_name AS gradeName, hp.position_code AS positionCode, COALESCE(cp.code_name, cg.code_name) AS positionName, ce.code_name AS employmentTypeName, cs.code_name AS serviceStatusName, hp.profile_photo_url AS profilePhotoUrl, hp.photo_url AS photoUrl, hp.ai_profile ->> 'summary' AS aiSummary, hd.dept_nm AS deptName, COALESCE(hp.extra_attributes ->> 'role', cp.code_name, cg.code_name) AS dutyName, hp.hire_date AS hireDate FROM hrm_person hp LEFT JOIN com_code cg ON hp.grade_code = cg.code AND cg.parent_code = '102' AND cg.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code cp ON hp.position_code = cp.code AND cp.parent_code = '103' AND cp.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code ce ON hp.employment_type_code = ce.code AND ce.parent_code = '104' AND ce.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code cs ON hp.service_status_code = cs.code AND cs.parent_code = '101' AND cs.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept hd ON hp.dept_cd = hd.dept_cd AND hd.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE hp.grade_code IS NOT NULL AND hp.service_status_code = '101-010' ORDER BY COALESCE(cg.sort_order, 9999), hp.employee_no

SELECT COALESCE(cst.code_name, he.school_type_code) AS schoolTypeName, he.school_name AS schoolName, COALESCE(cd.code_name, he.degree_code) AS degreeName, he.major AS major, COALESCE(cgs.code_name, he.graduation_status_code) AS graduationStatusName, he.admission_date AS admissionDate, he.graduation_date AS graduationDate, he.is_final_education AS finalEducation FROM hrm_education he LEFT JOIN com_code cst ON he.school_type_code = cst.code AND cst.parent_code = '110' AND cst.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code cgs ON he.graduation_status_code = cgs.code AND cgs.parent_code = '120' AND cgs.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code cd ON he.degree_code = cd.code AND cd.parent_code = '130' AND cd.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE he.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND he.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY he.admission_date NULLS LAST, he.graduation_date NULLS LAST

SELECT hc.company_name AS companyName, hc.hire_date AS hireDate, hc.retire_date AS retireDate, COALESCE(ce.code_name, hc.employment_type_code) AS employmentTypeName, hc.job_title AS jobTitle, hc.job_responsibility AS jobResponsibility FROM hrm_career hc LEFT JOIN com_code ce ON hc.employment_type_code = ce.code AND ce.parent_code = '104' AND ce.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE hc.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND hc.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY hc.hire_date DESC, hc.career_key
